statement_blocker: The repository supplies only the Petrov-Galerkin method name and the gloss 'a generalized Galerkin method'. It fixes no scalar field, trial and test spaces, continuous or discrete variational problem, bilinear or sesquilinear convention, right-hand side, inf-sup or kernel hypotheses, approximation family, norms, constants, ordered binders, or conclusion. Selecting well-posedness, stability, quasi-optimality, convergence, a Fortin criterion, or one concrete finite-element result would invent proposition-changing mathematics.
